name: smart-cookie-consent-manager
description: Development tooling for the Smart Cookie Consent Manager WordPress plugin (not needed to run the plugin).

scripts.lint: find . -name '*.php' -not -path './node_modules/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l > /dev/null && node --check assets/js/sccm-frontend.js && node --check assets/js/sccm-boot.js && node --check assets/js/sccm-admin.js && echo 'Lint OK'
